name: Bailor Stonehand
summary: In Thelsamar, Bailor Stonehand’s forge work has been set back by stolen ore. The skilled dwarven smith once taught the human weaponsmith Jordan Stilwell and makes a specialized alloy for masterwork arms.

sections.title: Master of the Forge
sections.body: Bailor Stonehand works the forge in Thelsamar, where his knowledge of minerals and specialized alloys reaches beyond Khaz Modan. He once taught Jordan Stilwell, a human smith, the foundations of metallurgy and shared formulas used to forge blessed paladin weapons such as Verigan's Fist.

sections.title: Ogre Ambush
sections.body: Mo'grosh ogres in the hills northeast of Thelsamar have stolen ore shipments meant for Bailor's forge. Without the raw material, he cannot make his rare alloys, and needs travelers and allies to recover the supplies from the ogres' encampments.

faq.answer: Bailor Stonehand is a veteran dwarven smith in Thelsamar, Loch Modan. He smelts rare metal alloys and once taught Jordan Stilwell the craft of weaponsmithing.

faq.q: What is Bailor's connection to Jordan Stilwell?
faq.answer: Bailor once taught Jordan Stilwell, a human smith near Ironforge, to work refined ore. He taught him a special alloy used to make the holy warhammer Verigan's Fist.
Mo'grosh ogres in Loch Modan's northeastern mounds intercepted and stole Bailor's raw ore shipment, leaving him without the materials for his specialized metalwork.

faq.q: Where can Bailor Stonehand be found?
faq.answer: Bailor can be found near the center of Thelsamar, the main dwarven town along Loch Modan's main road.

angles.text: As a paladin, you follow a craft Bailor taught Jordan Stilwell: his specialized alloy formula is used to make the sacred hammer Verigan's Fist.
As a blacksmith, you can see in Bailor the dwarven pursuit of rare, resilient metals. His specialized alloys are known across Khaz Modan.
